notes: Spec #85 UI evidence. Captures live in <ticket>/ folders; each entry carries its own device, OS and notes, because the tickets use different surfaces.

screenshots.caption: #93 Windows board, Today, light: 🔥 streaks on rows beside the count and in your summary; 1-day and no-data rows show none

capture.device: Chromium (in-app browser) on macOS, mocked Tauri IPC, 380×620 board at 2x

screenshots.notes: Windows board, not WebView2 on Windows: the real app UI (windows/src/app.ts and style.css) served by vite and fed the Sample board through windows/fixture.html (mocked Tauri IPC, data in windows/src/sample-board.ts). macOS system fonts instead of Segoe UI; no window chrome or tray. Streak cases on show: 365+ (ines-volk, a 371-day run), 23, 12 (you, also in the summary), 2 (ezra-q), 1 (bram-ott, hidden), and no data (niko-vane, failed: no streak). No before capture: the fixture page is new in this change, so there is no baseline board to compare. Recipe: cd windows && npm run dev, open http://127.0.0.1:1420/fixture.html?view=board, resize to 380×620.
